verdict.rationale: Probes confirm a live llms.txt at docs.github.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200) and markdown renditions of Copilot docs such as docs.github.com/copilot.md. Documentation pages are also served at .md URLs, so an agent can be pointed at machine-readable docs. Missing for 10: first-party documentation describing the llms.txt or agent-oriented docs offering, confirmation that the llms.txt is Copilot-specific rather than GitHub-wide, and independent or community corroboration of agents using these docs.
